_comment: Slither configuration for Tegridy Farms. Matches contracts/foundry.toml so static-analysis sees the same compilation as forge. Detector tuning: mute the false-positive-heavy classes that the existing audit ledger already excluded, surface every detector that maps to a Critical/High finding class.
_compilation: Slither uses crytic-compile under the hood; pointing it at the contracts/ subdir lets it pick up foundry.toml automatically (solc 0.8.26, via_ir=true, optimizer_runs=10, evm_version=cancun).
_detectors: Detector list. The default list is good but several are noise-heavy in this codebase (intentional unchecked math in Uniswap-V2 cumulatives, intentional storage layout in upgradable patterns we do not use). Mute those. Promote everything that maps to a fund-loss class.

_detectors_excluded_rationale.naming-convention: False positives on UPPERCASE constants and underscore-prefixed internals; covered by review
_detectors_excluded_rationale.solc-version: Pinned to 0.8.26 in foundry.toml, single-version project
_detectors_excluded_rationale.low-level-calls: Used intentionally for ETH transfers via WETHFallbackLib + 10k stipend pattern (Seaport-style)
_detectors_excluded_rationale.assembly: Used by OpenZeppelin and FixedPointMathLib internals; review explicitly
_detectors_excluded_rationale.similar-names: False positive heavy on (token0, token1), (reserve0, reserve1)
_detectors_excluded_rationale.too-many-digits: Constants like 10000 BPS and 1e18 are intentional
_detectors_excluded_rationale.constable-states: Working tree has Wave-014 changes converting some constants to state for timelocked tunability
_detectors_excluded_rationale.dead-code: Many helpers retained for ABI compatibility and future use

_detectors_promoted: These are the detectors that catch actual fund-loss patterns. Keep them firing loud.
_severity_floor: Slither default is medium. Bank-grade: surface low+ for review.
_workflow_integration: The existing .github/workflows/slither.yml should consume this file via `--config-file slither.config.json`. CI gate: fail PR on any new High or Medium finding. Low/Info reported to PR comment but non-blocking.
